epa_historical_comparator.rule: Do not reconstruct 2025Q3 membership from 2026Q3 rows using FIRST_REPORTED_DATE, PWS_DEACTIVATION_DATE, names, prefixes, or count arithmetic.

noncanonical_findings: PR000 prefix does not reproduce the PRDOH PRASA denominator of 160.
OWNER_TYPE_CODE does not reproduce the PRDOH PRASA/Non-PRASA partition.
PRASA-associated phone metadata does not reproduce 160 and also appears on Non-PR000 systems.
Current 2026 lifecycle dates cannot reconstruct a missing 2025Q3 quarterly snapshot without assuming activation semantics not established by the source.

hard_guardrails: Do not use the October 2026 PRDOH page as a member-level substitute for the September 2025 inventory.
Do not select 463 of EPA 2026Q3's 464 active systems by deletion.
Do not infer PRASA from PWSID prefix, owner code, phone, name, geography, or count equality.
Do not reconstruct EPA 2025Q3 membership from current lifecycle fields unless EPA supplies an authoritative historical snapshot or documented reconstruction contract.
